name: Retail & E-Commerce Commerce Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Retail and E-Commerce, covering product catalog curation, dynamic pricing & promotion rules, shopping cart persistence, multi-step checkout, payment gateway integration, fraud screening, order orchestration, shipping fulfillment, returns, and customer loyalty programs.

checklists.name: Retail & E-Commerce Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for catalog pricing, cart calculations, fraud screening, carrier shipping, and customer loyalty.

items.statement: Product catalog displays accurate SKU pricing, tax category codes, and real-time inventory availability.
Checkout cart calculates sales tax based on customer delivery address and applies valid promo codes.
Fraud screening flags high-risk orders and triggers 3D-Secure 2.0 challenge authentication.
Order orchestration routes orders to nearest fulfillment center or store location (BOPIS).
Customer loyalty rewards points calculate and update accurately upon order completion.

reviewGates.name: E-Commerce Commerce Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The E-Commerce Director confirms that cart pricing, tax engine, fraud screening, and fulfillment workflows satisfy retail benchmarks.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the e-commerce platform package confirm cart calculation accuracy and fraud screening enforcement?
